units.source_text: 那些尸体的拇指上都被穿上了铁丝，铁丝上挂着牌子，牌子上写着姓名、年龄等。

en.t: Wires had been threaded through the thumbs of those corpses, tags hung from the wires, and the tags bore their names, ages, and other details.

units.source_text: 他的朋友弓着腰，灵活地操作解剖刀，开始剥一具尸体脸上的皮。

en.t: His friend bent over, deftly handled the dissecting knife, and began peeling the skin from the face of a corpse.

units.source_text: 皮下是非常美丽的黄色脂肪。

en.t: Beneath the skin was very beautiful yellow fat.
